description: Synthetic sesslint.checks.compaction_snapshot parity (stdlib-only vectors; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: check_compaction_snapshot uses make_finding with the fingerprint omitted; Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE (known gap).
Python int is unbounded; Rust uses checked i64 for indexes and occurrence counts (PYTHON_INT_UNBOUNDED).
A bool is not an int. A float or other non-string kind is not a boundary.
MapWalk::Borrowed and ListWalk::Borrowed are failed borrows, not empty collections.
